name: Sale
title: B. Sale
legend: Once Bob got to a sale of old TV sets. There were n TV sets at that sale. TV set with index i costs ai bellars. Some TV sets have a negative price — their owners are ready to pay Bob if he buys their useless apparatus. Bob can «buy» any TV sets he wants. Though he's very strong, Bob can carry at most m TV sets, and he has no desire to go to the sale for the second time. Please, help Bob find out the maximum sum of money that he can earn.
input_spec: The first line contains two space-separated integers n and m (1 ≤ m ≤ n ≤ 100) — amount of TV sets at the sale, and amount of TV sets that Bob can carry. The following line contains n space-separated integers ai ( - 1000 ≤ ai ≤ 1000) — prices of the TV sets.
output_spec: Output the only number — the maximum sum of money that Bob can earn, given that he can carry at most m TV sets.
